notes.list_status: Certified. The page reads 'During the period starting on May 1, 2026 and ending on nomination day, August 21, 2026, the following persons filed all necessary papers, declarations and fees and have been certified as candidates for the office under which they are listed.'
notes.source_note: Each ward heading is followed by two sub-headings, 'Town Councillor candidates' and 'Town and Regional Councillor candidates', which are the ward and regional councillor races respectively.
notes.race_type_choice: Oakville runs two ward races. 'Councillor for the Town of Oakville' is filed under 'ward'; 'Councillor for the Town of Oakville and the Region of Halton' is filed under 'regional councillor', since it is the seat that also sits on Halton Region. Both are ward-based, so they would otherwise collide on one key.
notes.structure_match: The Offices to be Elected page states 'Seven to be elected, one in each ward' for each of the two councillor offices, matching both structure-CSV rows.
notes.position: From the page's headings, 'Mayor of the Town of Oakville', 'Town Councillor candidates' and 'Town and Regional Councillor candidates'. Oakville's upper-tier seat is a town seat as well, hence the compound title.
notes.withdrawals: Two Town and Regional Councillor candidates carry a '(withdrawn)' suffix and a withdrawal date, and are excluded here: Zena Al-Mudaris in Ward 6 (2026-08-21) and Riaz Ahmad Sinawan in Ward 7 (2026-08-20). Al-Mudaris is listed without the suffix in Ward 2, so she changed wards rather than leaving the ballot.
notes.name_changes: Two Ward 4 names are published differently than on 2026-08-11. 'Syed Hasan Tahir' is now 'Syed Tahir', and the regional candidate collected as 'Lee Hutchison' is now 'Hutchison Lee' — the page's own email (hutchisonleeforward4@) and site (hleeforward4.ca) put the surname as Lee, so the new order is the one recorded.
